scripts.dev: pnpm wasm && pnpm bindgen && vite web
scripts.build: pnpm wasm --config profile.wasm.lto=true --config profile.wasm.codegen-units=1 --config profile.wasm.incremental=false && pnpm bindgen && vite build web --base ./
scripts.test: cargo test --no-fail-fast -p fcc -p bake && cargo test --release --no-fail-fast -p parallax-native -p worldgen -p worlds -p cheese -- --skip keeps_the_contract:: --skip turned:: --skip even::
scripts.test:worlds: cargo test --release --no-fail-fast -p worlds --test contract --test directions --test places
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm wasm && pnpm test
